acceptanceCriteria: test-read-scopes-check reports a declared package whose test builds a tracked repository path from filepath.Join string segments (for example "protocol", "cem-1.0", "stable", "neutral-criterion") outside its declared scope
Proven on the cmd/corvint-cem-candidate next_action_test.go shape at d114cc62e, which the check passed
body: Batch PR #1357 (CI run 39496979738, go-product-shard 7): TestCEMV1350PlainAssemblyNextActionVerifiesBundle failed with 'open .../protocol/cem-1.0/stable/neutral-criterion/repository.recipe.json: permission denied'. The test (V1-2105, commit d114cc62e) builds the path with filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(file), "..", "..", "protocol", "cem-1.0", "stable", "neutral-criterion"), and cmd/corvint-cem-candidate declared no read scopes. 'go run ./tools/test-read-scopes-check' printed ok at that commit because it only matches whole path string literals (AFP-V0-023). Fixed for this case in eb36f78f3 by declaring the directory. Expected: the check joins adjacent string-literal arguments of filepath.Join/path.Join (or otherwise resolves runtime.Caller-relative joins) and flags the out-of-scope tracked path. Actual: the check passes and CI fails with a content-looking permission error.
